title: [review] project-LICHEN-636h.3: CBOR helpers lack bounds checks (P2)
description:
Files:
- lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_keys.c:80-118
- lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_msg.c:36-87

cbor_put_map_header, cbor_put_array_header, cbor_put_tstr, and cbor_put_uint take no buf_size parameter and perform no bounds checks. They silently write past the buffer if a caller miscalculates remaining space.

Currently mitigated by small Kconfig bounds (entries <= 16, inbox <= 8) and per-entry guards in some callers, but the helper functions themselves provide no safety net. Additionally, cbor_put_map_header and cbor_put_array_header accept size_t count but only handle up to UINT16_MAX — counts > 65535 silently produce truncated 2-byte CBOR headers (would need 0xba/0x9a 4-byte follow per RFC 8949).

Fix (optional): Add buf_size parameter to helpers and return -ENOSPC on overflow. Add 4-byte follow path (0xba/0x9a) for counts > 65535.
